mapper.sql: v.id AS run_id,v.policy_id,v.policy_row_version,v.rule_release_id,v.rule_row_version,v.snapshot_hash, v.run_status_code,v.row_version,v.requested_by,v.idempotency_key,v.request_hash, v.lease_token,v.lease_expires_at,v.error_code,v.created_at,v.started_at,v.completed_at, (p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND p.row_version=v.policy_row_version AND p.rule_release_id=v.rule_release_id AND r.row_version=v.rule_row_version AND r.release_status_code IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')) AS input_versions_current
FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs v JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=v.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=v.rule_release_id
mapper.select: -- 짧은 예약/claim/취소만 직렬화한다. 파일 실행 중 transaction lock은 유지하지 않는다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(73104)::text
-- service가 policy/run 범위를 함께 확인한다. runtime 현재성은 DB 버전 표시와 구분한다. SELECT WHERE v.id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE OF v
-- 최초 요청 키는 결과/버전이 바뀌어도 같은 run을 찾는다. SELECT WHERE v.idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 전역 큐 잠금 아래 하나의 예약만 claim한다. SELECT WHERE v.run_status_code='PENDING' ORDER BY v.created_at,v.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF v
-- 목록과 동일한 정책 범위 집계. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs WHERE policy_id=#{policyId}

-- 단계별 서버 실행 증거 이력은 불변이다. SELECT run_id,step_code,status_code,evidence_json::text AS evidence_json,evidence_hash,created_at FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_steps WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY created_at,step_code

-- 운영 대상은 활성·미삭제 수집원 전부다. 실패한 source도 범위에서 빼지 않는다. -- 시스템 profile의 설정 변화만 hash에 포함한다. 수집 시각/actor 등 업무 metadata는 제외한다. SELECT s.id AS source_id,s.public_code,s.parser_profile_code,s.notice_url, (to_jsonb(p)-'created_at'-'updated_at'-'created_by'-'updated_by')::text AS profile_configuration_json FROM local_government_notice_sources s LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_parser_profiles p ON p.profile_code=s.parser_profile_code WHERE s.is_enabled AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1001
-- 여러 정책 QA의 CPU/디스크 폭주를 막는다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs WHERE run_status_code IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')
-- 실패/취소도 실행 요청 한도를 소비한다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs WHERE policy_id=#{policyId} AND created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
-- 동일 정책 연속 예약은 60초 간격이다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs WHERE policy_id=#{policyId} AND created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')
mapper.insert: -- 예약은 성공이 아니다. 사용자는 snapshot/결과/lease를 제출할 수 없다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs(id,policy_id,policy_row_version,rule_release_id,rule_row_version, snapshot_hash,input_snapshot_json,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash) VALUES (#{runId},#{policyId},#{policyVersion},#{ruleReleaseId},#{ruleVersion},#{snapshotHash},CAST(#{inputSnapshotJson} AS jsonb),#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash})
mapper.update: -- 현재 14개 합성 파일과 정리 여유를 위한 8분 lease. 40초 잔여 검사와 기존 상한을 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs SET run_status_code='RUNNING',row_version=row_version+1, lease_token=#{leaseToken},lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '8 minutes',started_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{runId} AND run_status_code='PENDING'
mapper.insert: -- 수집 worker와 같은 전역 slot이다. 살아 있는 소유자를 덮어쓰지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_resource_leases(resource_code,resource_key,slot_no,policy_validation_id, policy_validation_lease_token,resource_lease_token,lease_expires_at) SELECT 'EXTRACTION','GLOBAL',1,id,lease_token,lease_token,lease_expires_at FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs WHERE id=#{runId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND run_status_code='RUNNING' ON CONFLICT (resource_code,resource_key,slot_no) DO UPDATE SET job_id=NULL,job_lease_token=NULL, provider_qa_case_id=NULL,provider_qa_lease_token=NULL, policy_validation_id=EXCLUDED.policy_validation_id,policy_validation_lease_token=EXCLUDED.policy_validation_lease_token, resource_lease_token=EXCLUDED.resource_lease_token,lease_expires_at=EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE announcement_attachment_resource_leases.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: -- 취소/만료/슬롯 상실이면 다음 파일을 실행하지 않는다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs v JOIN announcement_attachment_resource_leases l ON l.policy_validation_id=v.id AND l.policy_validation_lease_token=v.lease_token WHERE v.id=#{runId} AND v.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND v.run_status_code='RUNNING' AND v.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()+interval '40 seconds' AND l.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()+interval '40 seconds')
mapper.update: -- 취소 요청은 성공/부분 성공으로 덮어쓰지 않는다. 만료 owner는 완료를 확정하지 못한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs SET run_status_code=CASE WHEN run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE #{statusCode} END, error_code=CASE WHEN run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN' ELSE #{errorCode} END, row_version=row_version+1,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{runId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND run_status_code IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()

-- PENDING은 즉시 취소, 실행 중이면 현재 파일 정리 후 취소한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs SET run_status_code=CASE WHEN run_status_code='PENDING' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' END, row_version=row_version+1,error_code='CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN', completed_at=CASE WHEN run_status_code='PENDING' THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{runId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND run_status_code IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

-- 사라진 프로세스를 재실행했다고 추정하지 않는다. 만료 실행은 실패로 남기고 새 예약에서 재검증한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs SET run_status_code='FAILED',error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', row_version=row_version+1,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE run_status_code IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.delete: -- 완료/취소된 자기 실행의 슬롯만 정리한다. 재할당된 슬롯은 보존한다. DELETE FROM announcement_attachment_resource_leases WHERE policy_validation_id=#{runId} AND policy_validation_lease_token=#{leaseToken}
